thread:
alex: FYI DSAR from EU user (ticket EU-4782). They want deletion of all personal data + embeddings. Need cross-team plan. :rotating_light:

maya-legal: We have 1 month. Need confirmation on scope: embeddings, logs, backups. Also confirm identity verification steps.

igor-infra: Backups are S3 snapshots encrypted with customer KMS (alias/redwood-prod-cmk). Snapshots retained 90 days. Deleting runtime index entries is easy; backups persist until TTL. If legal requires full purge, we need to do targeted object deletes and possibly rekeying.

sara-ml: We store dense vectors in vectordb project `semsearch-prod`. We can call internal delete endpoint: ```POST /internal/v1/data/delete
body: {user_id: 'eu-usr-123'}
response: {deleted_vectors: 203, deleted_meta: 17}``` After that we should evict KV caches and re-check quantization/indices.

ben-sec: Two items: 1) Audit trail must include actor, request_id, timestamp, and signed export. We push to immutable `audit-stream`. 2) RBAC: only a new `data-eraser` role should be able to run deletions. Prototype perm set: ```iam.allow('data-eraser', ['vectordb.delete', 's3.deleteObjects', 'audit.write'])``` Also KMS key policy will need a clause to allow infra to delete objects when asked by legal.

lena-support: What should we tell the requester now? Can we say "processing; may need up to 30 days; backups may take longer"?

alex: @maya-legal confirm no legal hold. @igor-infra can you enumerate backup ranges and whether we can do targeted purge with customer's KMS? @ben-sec please draft RBAC delta. @sara-ml prepare delete runbook and cache invalidation steps.

ops-bot: backup-retention job snapshot created 1775508000 for semsearch-prod (encrypted:kms:alias/redwood-prod).

igor-infra: Snapshot list (quick): weekly 2026-01-04 -> 2026-03-28. We can do targeted deletes if key policy allows. Note: if S3 Object Lock or legal hold is enabled we can't delete until cleared. Checking key ownership (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).

maya-legal: No legal hold for this user. Proceed with deletion. Need templated email confirming deletion when complete and require proof of deletion: signed audit export attached to ticket.

ben-sec: Also flag: minor auth vuln in vectordb plugin found yesterday (affects privileged ops). PR #3425 in review. Recommend we hold full-prod deletion until patch is deployed — prevents misuse of delete endpoint during window. ETA patch ~18h.

sara-ml: Ok will stage canary deletion in staging with a representative user. Canary runbook: 1) stop ingestion for target dataset, 2) call delete endpoint, 3) evict KV cache: `curl -X POST https://kv.example.internal/evict?user_id=eu-usr-123`, 4) run audit export to `s3://audit-exports/eu-4782.json`, 5) attach export to ticket.

alex: If vuln blocks prod deletion timeline, what's acceptable interim user message?

maya-legal: Tell them: "We're processing your request; deletion is underway. We may take a short additional time to complete security checks and final verification." That's compliant.

ben-sec: I'll finalize RBAC changes and add a `delete-operation` audit hook that signs records with HMAC and stores to `audit-stream`. Will coordinate KMS policy change with infra.

lena-support: I'll draft the interim reply and the final confirmation template.

thomas-pm: Recording action items: (1) ben -> RBAC + audit hook (2) igor -> backup enumeration + KMS policy check (3) sara -> delete runbook + canary (4) maya -> user template + confirm no hold (5) lena -> send interim reply (6) ben -> follow up on vuln PR and deployment window.

alex: Thanks all. Please update ticket EU-4782 when you start each step. I'll follow up in the morning. :thumbsup:
